questions.q: where is it decided that http means 80 and ftp means 21 when no port is written out
questions.why: parser.rs has `pub fn default_port(scheme: &str) -> Option<u16>` matching http/ws=80, https/wss=443, ftp=21

questions.q: where do the .. and . segments actually get collapsed while a path is being parsed
questions.why: Parser::parse_path matches segment_before_slash against ".."/"%2e%2e"/"." etc and calls shorten_path/pop_path, both defined just below

questions.q: which byte sets does it escape in a fragment versus a query, and does the query set change for http vs a custom scheme
questions.why: the FRAGMENT, PATH, USERINFO, PATH_SEGMENT, QUERY and SPECIAL_QUERY AsciiSet consts are at the top of parser.rs; SPECIAL_QUERY adds b'\''

questions.q: if the authority contains more than one @ sign, which one splits the credentials from the host
questions.why: Parser::parse_userinfo scans for the last '@' (last_at) before /?#, then splits username/password on the first ':'

questions.q: what happens to a tab or a newline sitting in the middle of the input string
questions.why: Input's Iterator::next filters ascii_tab_or_new_line, new_trim_* trims them at the ends and reports SyntaxViolation::TabOrNewlineIgnored

questions.q: why does a file URL whose authority is localhost come back with no host at all
questions.why: Parser::get_file_host and parse_file_host both map Host::Domain("localhost") to an empty/None host

questions.q: there is some special handling that inserts a slash-dot after the colon for schemeless-authority URLs - where is that
questions.why: Parser::with_query_and_fragment inserts "/." at path_start when a no-authority URL's path starts with "//", and removes it in the reverse case

questions.q: how does it render the port digits into the serialization without building a temporary String
questions.why: fast_u16_to_str writes digits backwards into a [u8; 5] buffer and returns a &str via from_utf8_unchecked; parse_host_and_port calls it

questions.q: does the host parser accept hex or leading-zero octal numbers in a dotted address
questions.why: parse_ipv4number picks radix 16 for 0x/0X, 8 for a leading 0, else 10, and parse_ipv4addr assembles the parts

questions.q: what picks the run of zero groups that gets replaced by the double colon when an IPv6 host is printed
questions.why: write_ipv6 uses longest_zero_sequence, which returns (-1,-2) when the longest run is shorter than 2 so lone zeroes are not compressed

questions.q: for a scheme the crate does not know about, which characters are outright rejected in the host
questions.why: Host::parse_opaque_cow has an is_invalid_host_char closure listing NUL, tab, LF, CR, space, # / : < > ? @ [ \ ] ^ |, then percent-encodes CONTROLS

questions.q: when parsing a URL with a non-ASCII hostname, where does the conversion to punycode happen
questions.why: Host::parse_cow calls idna::domain_to_ascii_from_cow(domain, idna::AsciiDenyList::URL) after percent-decoding

questions.q: is there a built-in way to compute the relative link that would get me from one URL to another
questions.why: Url::make_relative walks the two paths, emits .. for the leftover base segments and appends query/fragment from the target

questions.q: under what conditions is changing the scheme on an existing Url refused
questions.why: Url::set_scheme rejects special<->non-special swaps, file with an authority, trailing input after the scheme, and special schemes with no host

questions.q: if I append query parameters on a URL that already has a fragment, how does the fragment survive
questions.why: query_pairs_mut calls take_fragment and stashes it in UrlQuery; Target::finish and the Drop impl call restore_already_parsed_fragment

questions.q: how is a Windows path with a drive prefix or a network share turned into a file URL
questions.why: path_to_file_url_segments_windows matches Component::Prefix Disk/VerbatimDisk and UNC/VerbatimUNC, writing the server as the host and the share as the first segment

questions.q: why do two URLs that both point at local files never compare as the same origin
questions.why: url_origin returns Origin::new_opaque() for "file", and new_opaque hands out a fresh id from a static AtomicUsize counter

questions.q: if a URL has no port, what do the before-port and after-port slice boundaries evaluate to
questions.why: Url::index for Position::BeforePort/AfterPort both return host_end when self.port is None; count_digits sizes the port span otherwise

questions.q: when I push a path segment that contains a slash or a percent sign, does it get escaped
questions.why: PathSegmentsMut::extend sets Context::PathSegmentSetter and skips "."/".."; parser.rs push_pending then encodes with PATH_SEGMENT (which adds '/' and '%') or SPECIAL_PATH_SEGMENT

questions.q: can I read the raw byte offsets of the components out of a parsed Url instead of re-scanning the string
questions.why: quirks.rs defines InternalComponents plus internal_components(url), both gated on the expose_internals feature
